svg.title: Adult neck mass decision chart: rule out normal structures, then midline (thyroid 90%) versus lateral (rule of 7s and age: infection, congenital or neoplasm, an older adult's lateral mass being cancer until proven otherwise) versus a salivary gland mass (stones and infection worse with meals, tumours painless); each column gives clues, investigations and treatment
